images.title: What each ad network asks for
images.alt: Entry requirements for AdSense, Raptive, Mediavine and Mediavine Journey, from no minimum traffic to set pageview, session or revenue thresholds.
images.caption: AdSense is the usual first step; premium networks set traffic or revenue thresholds.
images.note: As listed in October 2026. Check each network's page before you plan.

items.title: Google AdSense
items.text: No minimum traffic number. Original content, policy compliance, age 18+.

items.title: Raptive
items.text: 25,000 monthly pageviews, traffic conditions, domain six months old.

items.title: Mediavine
items.text: At least $5,000 in annual ad revenue.

items.title: Mediavine Journey
items.text: 1,000 sessions in 30 days from the US, Canada, the UK or Australia.

images.title: Wait for evidence before you build
images.alt: Steps before making a digital product: watch for repeated reader demand, test the idea with a small paid version, then price it without assuming cheap is safe.
images.caption: The common failure is making a product nobody asked for, so let readers show you first.

items.title: Watch for repeated questions
items.text: Readers keep asking about one problem, or email asking if you offer something.

items.title: Spot the standout article
items.text: One post draws far more engagement than the rest.

items.title: Test before you build
items.text: Validate the idea, ideally with a small paid version.

items.title: Plan for upkeep
items.text: After launch you handle refunds, questions and updates.

images.title: Which model fits your blog now
images.alt: Five situations matched to a model: affiliate links, an email list, display ads, a digital product, or ads and affiliates when time is short.
images.caption: Match the model to the traffic and topic you have today, not the ones you hope to have.

items.title: Low traffic, commercial
items.text: Affiliate links first. Write articles that help people choose.

items.title: Low traffic, no products
items.text: Skip monetizing for now and build an email list.

items.title: High traffic, general
items.text: Display ads, then a premium network once you qualify.

items.title: Small, trusting audience
items.text: A digital product or paid newsletter, once readers show what they want.

items.title: Very little time
items.text: Ads and affiliate links need the least upkeep.
